section: ER-02 Site conditions and design data
text: Seawater quality, temperature and marine conditions per ALP-OWN-MAR-001 (two-layer sea, pycnocline at 20 m to 25 m). Design range at the intake depth 6.9 degC to 27.0 degC, chloride up to 14,500 mg/l, TSS up to 140 mg/l in storms, occasional H2S in the lower layer, mussel settlement, jellyfish blooms up to 20 kg/m3 and mucilage events.
title: Seawater conditions
